info.title: Flung API
info.description: Schedule, publish and automate social media posts.

apiKey.description: An API key (flung_sk_...), an OAuth access token from Flung's authorization server (/.well-known/oauth-authorization-server), or, for the few calls a connect panel makes, a connect token (flung_ct_...).

profileId.description: The profile the post was made for, or null.

performance.description: The counts Flung keeps for a published post, summed over its accounts: read an hour, a day, a week and a month after it goes out on plans with `performanceDays`, and whenever its metrics are read. A count no platform reports is null; null until first read.

tagIds.description: The tags on the post. Not in webhook payloads.

publishAtLocal.description: The same instant as the local time in `timeZone`, with its offset.

timeZone.description: The IANA zone of `publishAtLocal`: the one the time was given in, or the caller's for a post from before zones were kept.

seriesId.description: The recurring series (`/v1/series`) this post is one date of; null for a one-off post.

occurrence.description: The date's place in its series, from 0; null for a one-off post.

media.description: Each of `mediaIds` as it can be shown now. Not in lists or webhook payloads.

warnings.description: Only when creating or changing a post: how a local `publishAt` that the clocks skip or repeat was read, and each file Flung resizes for a platform.

available.description: What the file shows from: `original` while Flung keeps it (30 days after its last post settled), then `preview` (a small copy kept for good), `platform` (the platform's own address, where it never expires), or `gone`.

previewUrl.description: An address to show the file from, as `available` says; null when `gone`. The original's is signed for an hour.

firstCommentId.description: The first comment's id on the platform, once it is posted.

firstCommentError.description: Why the first comment failed. The post itself is unaffected.

thread.description: A thread's later parts on the platform, in order (`platformPostId` is the first), and why the rest could not be posted; null when the post is not a thread.

allOf.description: For `repeat_duplicate_text`: the platform that may refuse or hide the repeated text. For `will_be_resized`: the platform the file is made smaller for.

mediaId.description: For `will_be_resized`: the file over the platform's size.

TimeWarning.description: Something the post was made despite: a local time that did not name exactly one instant, and how it was read; for a repeating post, text with no changing variable going more often than weekly to a platform that refuses or hides the same text twice; or a file over a platform's size, which Flung sends that platform a smaller copy of when the post goes out (`will_be_resized`).

RepeatRule.description: Makes the post repeat: a series (`/v1/series`) whose first date is `publishAt`, each date its own post, made when the one before settles. The answer is the first date's post, with its `seriesId`. The plan limits how many series run at once.

profileId.description: The profile the post was made for, or null.

performance.description: The counts Flung keeps for a published post, summed over its accounts: read an hour, a day, a week and a month after it goes out on plans with `performanceDays`, and whenever its metrics are read. A count no platform reports is null; null until first read.

tagIds.description: The tags on the post. Not in webhook payloads.

publishAtLocal.description: The same instant as the local time in `timeZone`, with its offset.

timeZone.description: The IANA zone of `publishAtLocal`: the one the time was given in, or the caller's for a post from before zones were kept.

seriesId.description: The recurring series (`/v1/series`) this post is one date of; null for a one-off post.

occurrence.description: The date's place in its series, from 0; null for a one-off post.

displayName.description: The name the platform shows for the account (a person, page, channel), when it gave one at connect time.

avatarUrl.description: The account's picture on the platform, an https address, as it was at connect time. Show it with `referrerpolicy="no-referrer"`.

profileUrl.description: Where the account can be seen on its platform: its profile, page or channel, an https address on the platform's own host. Null where the platform gives no public address for it, such as a LinkedIn member's own profile.

profileId.description: The profile the account belongs to, or null for the workspace as a whole.

status.description: `needs_reconnect`: the platform refused the token; start a reconnect.

renewal.description: `automatic`: Flung refreshes the token before it expires, until `reconnectBy` if set. `manual`: only a reconnect renews it, by `reconnectBy`. `not_needed`: the token does not expire.

tokenExpiresAt.description: When the current access token expires. Flung renews `automatic` ones about a day before.

reconnectBy.description: The last moment the account works without a reconnect; null when it renews indefinitely. Flung sends `account.reconnect_required_soon` a week before.

defaultBoard.description: Pinterest only: where pins go unless a post picks another board.

enabled.description: Whether comments and mentions are read. null is the platform's default: on, except X, where reading costs money.

error.description: Why the last read failed, such as a missing permission.

inbox.description: Reading comments and mentions into GET /v1/inbox.

result.description: `refreshed`: a new token is stored. `not_needed`: this account has nothing to refresh. `reconnect_required`: the platform refused; the account is now `needs_reconnect`. `failed`: a temporary platform failure; try again later.

privacyLevels.description: The audiences this account may post to now: TikTok's privacy levels (pass one as platformOverrides.tiktok.privacyLevel), or YouTube's visibilities (platformOverrides.youtube.visibility).

commentsDisabled.description: The creator turned comments off; posts cannot allow them.

maxVideoSeconds.description: The longest video this account may post. On YouTube, 15 minutes until the channel is verified.

categories.description: The categories the channel may pick, for platformOverrides.youtube.categoryId.

longUploads.description: YouTube's `longUploadsStatus`: `allowed` lifts the 15-minute limit; `eligible` means the channel can verify at youtube.com/verify.

plan.description: The plan: free, pro ($19 a month) or business ($59 a month).

source.description: Where the plan comes from: no subscription, a paying Stripe subscription, or set by Flung.

status.description: The subscription's Stripe status, or none.

usage.description: What counts against each limit now.

upgradeUrl.description: The workspace's Plan page on the Flung portal, where an owner upgrades.

accounts.description: Connected social accounts that are not disconnected.

postsPerMonth.description: Posts created in one UTC calendar month; a post counts once however many accounts it goes to.

requestsPerMinute.description: Requests a minute for each API key, OAuth app or connect token.

tags.description: Tags a workspace keeps.

tagsPerPost.description: Tags on one post or saved post.

accountsPerPlatformPerProfile.description: Live accounts of one platform in one profile, the accounts outside every profile counting as one profile; a LinkedIn page counts apart from a LinkedIn profile. Across the workspace a platform also has at most this times `profiles`. A second is refused with `platform_limit_reached`. null is no limit.

members.description: Seats: the people in the workspace, each with a role, counting anyone added who has not signed in yet.

aiCreditsPerMonth.description: AI credits a UTC calendar month for Flungie, the assistant in the Flung portal: one credit is 4,000 weighted tokens by default (tokens read count a quarter), so most messages cost one or two credits.

activeSeries.description: Recurring posts (`/v1/series`) active or paused at once; one ended or stopped frees its slot. null is no limit.

threadParts.description: Parts one thread may have on X, Bluesky, Threads and Mastodon (`thread: true` on a post). A longer one is refused with `plan_limit_reached`.

performanceDays.description: Days after publishing that Flung keeps reading a post's views, likes, comments and reposts, so posts can be listed by them (`sort`). 0: not kept; one post's counts are still read with GET /v1/posts/{id}/metrics.

left.description: Every AI credit Flungie can spend now: this month's left and the bought ones left.

month.description: This UTC month's credits from the plan (and any Flung granted for it), spent first. They renew on the 1st.

bought.description: The credits the unexpired packs were bought with.

nextExpiresAt.description: When the pack spent next expires; null when it never does or none is left.

lots.description: Each unexpired pack with credits left, in the order they are spent: soonest expiry first.

purchased.description: Credits bought in packs from the portal, spent once the month's are, soonest expiry first. Packs are bought by a person in the portal, never through the API.

BillingCredits.description: Flungie's AI credits: the month's from the plan and the ones bought in packs.

secret.description: The signing secret (Standard Webhooks, `whsec_...`). Shown only in this response; store it now.
The new signing secret. Shown only in this response.

previousSecretExpiresAt.description: Until then, deliveries carry signatures from both secrets.

eventType.description: An event type, or `webhook.ping` for a test.

token.description: Hand this to the page (`<flung-connect token>`). It can only list, connect, reconnect and disconnect accounts.

accountId.description: The account being reconnected; null for a new connection.

status.description: `pending` until the person finishes on the platform; `expired` when they did not by `expiresAt`.

authorizationUrl.description: Send the person here: the platform's own consent page. Null once the session has ended.

expiresAt.description: The person must finish by then.

accountIds.description: The accounts stored, once `connected`. Facebook connects one per page.

prefix.description: The start of the key, to tell keys apart.

key.description: The secret key. Shown only in this response; store it now.

prefix.description: The start of the key, to tell keys apart.

userId.description: The person who approved the app, for an OAuth token; null for an API key.

plan.description: The plan: free, pro ($19 a month) or business ($59 a month).

timeZone.description: The IANA zone a local `publishAt` without `timeZone` is read in: the person's for an OAuth token, else the workspace's default, else UTC.

timeZoneSource.description: Where `timeZone` came from: the person's profile, the workspace's default, or neither (UTC).

nowLocal.description: The time now in `timeZone`, with its offset.

role.description: What the member may do in the workspace: `owner` everything; `manager` everything but billing and deleting it; `marketing`, `developer` and `member` their own share; `reader` reads only. Staff may narrow a role for a workspace (docs: workspace roles).

uploadUrl.description: For a file up to 100 MB: PUT it here, with your credential and its Content-Length. Null for a multipart upload.

partSize.description: Every part but the last is exactly this many bytes.

partUrl.description: PUT each part to this address with `{partNumber}` replaced by 1 to partCount, in any order.

completeUrl.description: POST here once every part is in.

multipart.description: For a file over 100 MB: how to send it in parts.

MediaType.description: What the file really is, read from its first bytes once uploaded.

altText.description: The alt text the file was imported with, such as a Plotwork diagram's name. Null for an upload.

status.description: `pending` until its bytes arrive; `ready` once a post can use it.

width.description: Its width in pixels as it plays, a rotation applied.

height.description: Its height in pixels as it plays.

video.description: A video's length and size, read from the file once uploaded; null for images, or when the file could not be read. YouTube uses them to tell a Short from a video.

status.description: `skipped` when the video is over 100 MB or this month's thumbnail allowance is used up. Posts never wait for a preview; they use the file as uploaded.

thumbnailUrl.description: A JPEG frame one second in, 640 pixels wide, at an address that does not expire.

hlsUrl.description: Always null for now: streaming versions are not made.

durationSeconds.description: The video's length in seconds; the same as `video.durationSeconds`.

preview.description: Videos only, where previews are set up: a thumbnail. Read the file again while `processing`.

kind.description: template: reusable, deployed as a post. draft: a post saved to finish later.

profileId.description: The profile (brand) it is written for, or null.

tagIds.description: The tags on it, which a post deployed from it takes.

system.description: Dynamic variables Flung fills in each time a post goes out, such as {{date}} and {{day_name}}, in the post's time zone.

facts.description: What a preview renders with besides the time: the workspace's name, its owner's country and the occasions for it, and the link tracking defaults.

kind.description: text: one fixed value. list: one of `values` each time a post goes out.

value.description: The text; for a list, its values joined by " | ".

mode.description: rotate: the next value each time it goes out. random: one at random, the same again on a retry.

category.description: What it is about: date, week (day and week), month (month and year), time, countdown, random (system lists too) or technical.

argument.description: What goes after a colon, as in {{days_until:2026-12-25}}; null when it takes none.

gate.description: A switch on a feature rather than a variable to write: locale (names in another language) and date_formats ({{date:FORMAT}}).

perTarget.description: Filled in for each account the post goes to: platform, handle, account_name and utm.

values.description: A system list's values; null for a built-in.

mode.description: rotate: the next value each time it goes out. random: one at random, the same again on a retry.

available.description: Whether this workspace's plan may use it.

plan.description: The cheapest plan that may use it.

template.description: The post text: `{{title}}`, `{{link}}`, `{{summary}}` from each item, and workspace variables.

saved.description: Drafts and templates with this tag.

targets.description: Sends on this platform by status.

state.description: The post as it stands on the person's screen. `publishAt` is local, read in their zone when they schedule it.

shared.description: Whether the person lets outside agents in.

canUndo.description: Whether a change made for the person can be put back.

ComposerPatch.description: The fields to change; those left out stay as they are.

allOf.description: The profile's own style when profileId was given and it has one, else null.
The style to write in: the workspace's, with each field the profile sets over it.

updatedAt.description: When the style asked for (the profile's, or the workspace's) last changed.

BrandStyle.description: The workspace's own style, or null when none is set.

connectable.description: Whether this Flung has the platform's app credentials, so accounts can be connected.

variants.description: The connect variants set up here, to pass as `variant` when connecting: LinkedIn's `pages` connects company pages.

connectFlow.description: How a connect ends. `consent`: the `authorizationUrl` is a sign-in page that sends the person back to `redirectUrl`. `approval` (Farcaster): it opens the platform's phone app to approve Flung, nothing comes back to `redirectUrl`, and the session finishes when it is read, so show the link (or a QR code of it) and poll `GET /v1/connect-sessions/{id}`.

maxImages.description: Images in one post; 0 when images are not accepted.

postsPerHour.description: How fast Flung publishes to one account, to stay inside the platform's limits.

tokensExpire.description: Whether connections expire; Flung renews them before they do where the platform allows.

destinations.description: Posts go to a destination chosen per post (Pinterest boards).

firstComment.description: Posts here can take `platformOverrides.<platform>.firstComment`.

threads.description: A long text goes here as a thread with `thread: true`: each part a reply to the one before, within `maxTextLength` as the platform counts it.

rank.description: 1 is the platform's best slot of the week.

publishAt.description: The local time with no offset, to pass to publishAt as it is.

at.description: The same moment with the zone's offset on that day.

note.description: Present when the clocks skip this time, so it moves later.

capped.description: The plan had more than 31 dates and stops there.

now.description: The time there now, with its offset.

brands.description: The workspace's brands (profiles); an account's profileId names its brand.

allOf.description: The style to write in, or null when none is set.

samples.description: With samples: recent published posts, newest first.

allOf.description: The post now scheduled for the next date, or null when none is.

status.description: `active`: its next date is scheduled as a post. `paused`: nothing is scheduled until it is resumed. `ended`: its count or until ran out. `stopped`: stopped for good.

pauseReason.description: Why it is paused: `person`, or `reconnect` when an account it posts to must be reconnected first. Null unless paused.

allOf.description: How often the post repeats, a small subset of iCalendar's RRULE: `freq` daily, weekly, monthly; `interval` every N days, weeks or months (1 to 365); `byWeekday` the weekdays of a weekly rule (mon, tue, wed, thu, fri, sat, sun), or with `bySetPos` the one weekday of a monthly "nth weekday" rule; `byMonthDay` a monthly rule's day (a month without it uses its last day); `bySetPos` 1 to 4, or -1 for the last; and an end, at most one of `count` (1 to 1000 dates, skipped ones included) or `until` (a local day, itself included). Without an end it repeats until stopped. Every date is at the first date's local time in `timeZone`, through daylight saving.

startAt.description: The local time of the first date, in `timeZone`; every date keeps its time of day.

summary.description: The rule in one line, for a person.
summary.example: Every 2 weeks on Monday at 09:00, starting Mon 9 Nov, no end date

nextAt.description: The next date, scheduled as a post; null when none is.

lastAt.description: The latest date made a post.

accountIds.description: The connected accounts to publish to.

publishAt.description: The first date: the local time a person said, such as `2026-11-09T09:00`, read in `timeZone`, or an instant. Every later date keeps its local time of day. A first date the rule does not fall on moves to the rule's next one. Omit to start now.

timeZone.description: An IANA time zone, such as `Europe/Athens`. Without one, a local `publishAt` is read in the zone of the person behind an OAuth token, else the workspace's default (GET /v1/me says which), else UTC. A zone that is not IANA is refused with `invalid_time_zone`.

profileId.description: The profile the post belongs to. Every account in `accountIds` must be in it.

firstComment.description: Commented on the post, as the account, right after it publishes. Only on linkedin, threads, instagram, youtube, bluesky, mastodon, farcaster, facebook. If it fails the post stays published, and the target's `firstCommentError` says why.

thread.description: Only on x, bluesky, threads, mastodon: the post as a thread, each part a reply to the one before, the files on the first. Each part within the platform's limit as it counts text; the plan limits the parts (`threadParts`). Usually left to `thread: true`, which cuts the text for each platform.

boardId.description: Pinterest only: the board to pin to, instead of the account's default board.

privacyLevel.description: TikTok only: who sees the video, one of the account's `privacyLevels` (GET /v1/accounts/{id}/posting-options). Defaults to the most public one allowed.

allowComments.description: TikTok only. Default true, unless the creator turned comments off.

allowDuet.description: TikTok only. Default true, unless the creator turned duets off.

allowStitch.description: TikTok only. Default true, unless the creator turned stitches off.

promotesOwnBrand.description: TikTok only: the video promotes the creator's own business.

brandedContent.description: TikTok only: a paid partnership promoting a third party. Not allowed with SELF_ONLY.

format.description: YouTube only: `video` or `short`. A Short is square or tall and at most 3 minutes; Flung adds #Shorts to its description. Unset, a video that fits a Short goes out as one.

title.description: YouTube only: the title, up to 100 characters, without < or >. Unset, the text's first line.

visibility.description: YouTube only: who sees it. Default `public`. Until Flung's Google project passes YouTube's audit, YouTube keeps every upload private.

madeForKids.description: YouTube only: made for children, which YouTube requires every channel to declare (COPPA). Default false.

tags.description: YouTube only: search tags, up to 500 characters together as YouTube counts them.

categoryId.description: YouTube only: a category id from GET /v1/accounts/{id}/posting-options. Default 22, People and Blogs.

notifySubscribers.description: YouTube only: tell the channel's subscribers. Default true.

containsSyntheticMedia.description: YouTube only: realistic altered or synthetic content YouTube must label.

Without an end it repeats until stopped. Every date is at the first date's local time in `timeZone`, through daylight saving.

occurrence.description: The date's place in the series, from 0.

upcoming.description: The next few dates the rule gives, the scheduled one first. Only the first is a post yet.

posts.description: The series' recent posts, newest date first: published, failed, skipped (cancelled) and the scheduled one.
